facts.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai is a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of gardens overlooking Dubai Creek.
facts.excerpt: a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of lush gardens overlooking the iconic Creek

facts.text: The hotel is located near the airport and major attractions, combining resort living with city access.
facts.excerpt: Ideally located near the airport and major attractions, the hotel blends serene resort living with effortless city access.

facts.text: The hotel is just outside of downtown Dubai.
facts.excerpt: Stay at our luxury hotel just outside of downtown Dubai

facts.text: The hotel has a 20,000-square-metre waterpark.
facts.excerpt: a spectacular 20,000 sqm waterpark, and the acclaimed Ahasees Spa

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark has 16 signature attractions and is designed for all generations.
facts.excerpt: Home to 16 signature attractions, Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark is thoughtfully designed for all generations

facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor pools and an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 2 outdoor pools, including one of the largest leisure pools in the city, and a 20-metre indoor pool.

facts.text: Ahasees Spa & Club experiences are guided by three core philosophies: Trade, Flourish and Evolve.
facts.excerpt: Guided by three core philosophies — Trade, Flourish, and Evolve — each experience is thoughtfully curated to nurture the body, calm the mind, and elevate the senses.

facts.text: The fitness centre at Ahasees Spa & Club has separate zones with cardio and strength-training equipment.
facts.excerpt: wellness enthusiasts can enjoy different levels of fitness activities in separate zones that feature cardio and strength-training equipment

facts.text: Skyline View rooms have Dubai skyline views and contemporary decor with Arabian touches.
facts.excerpt: Revel in stunning Dubai skyline views from this 39-square-metre room with contemporary decor and Arabian touches.

facts.text: Rooms have an Italian bathroom with twin basins and a separate tub and shower.
facts.excerpt: The room features one king bed, Italian bathroom with twin basins and separate tub and shower, along with a generous work area.

facts.text: Superior rooms are adorned with Arabian influences and have views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in a spacious 44-square-meter room adorned with Arabian influences and boasting breathtaking views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.

facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Royal Suite has a spacious parlor, dining for eight, a kitchenette and a marble bathroom with a jetted spa bathtub.
facts.excerpt: spacious parlor, dining for eight, kitchenette, wetbar, work area with minibar, complimentary high-speed internet, and marble bathroom with jetted spa bathtub, shower, and bidet

facts.text: Butler service is available on request in the 2 Bedroom Royal Suite.
facts.excerpt: Butler service is available on request.

facts.text: The adults-only Grand Club Lounge offers an extended continental breakfast, daily refreshments and evening cocktail hours.
facts.excerpt: Discover the new adults-only Grand Club Lounge, an exclusive space for corporate guests, direct customers, and World of Hyatt Globalist Members. Guests can enjoy an extended continental breakfast, daily refreshments, and cocktail hours in the evening.

facts.text: Panini is a delicatessen set amid tropical indoor gardens and waterfalls, known for its strawberry cheesecake.
facts.excerpt: Set amid tropical indoor gardens and flowing waterfalls, Panini is a classic delicatessen offering specialty house-made breads, pastries, and gelato. Known for its signature strawberry cheesecake

facts.text: Wox serves Pan-Asian street-food-inspired dishes at an intimate chef's table where the chef cooks over woks.
facts.excerpt: Wox draws inspiration from Pan-Asian street food and brings it to an intimate chef

facts.text: The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues with personalized planning.
facts.excerpt: With elegant indoor and outdoor venues, personalized planning, and thoughtful details

facts.text: The hotel offers 12,500 square metres of event space, from ballrooms to meeting rooms.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Dubai offers 12,500 square metres of flexible event space, from grand ballrooms to intimate meeting rooms

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available and is complimentary for hotel guests or guests attending hotel-based events.

facts.text: The hotel has three complimentary EV chargers.
facts.excerpt: We also feature three complimentary EV chargers, available 24 hours, with no reservation required.

facts.text: The hotel has 11 award-winning restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: 11 award-winning restaurants and bars at Grand Hyatt Dubai
